text: 男人的真实一面是什么呢？
en: What is a man's true side?

text: 在看似每个人都不一样的生活中，找寻着每个人的共鸣
en: In lives that seem so different for everyone, we search for the resonance within each person.

text: 从小时候起，生活只有吃喝和玩具，
en: From childhood, life held only food, drink and toys,

text: 玩泥巴也行
en: Playing in the mud was fine too

text: 不知从什么时候开始，加了一项学习，
en: I don't know since when, but a thing called studying was added,

text: 背上的书包压得人喘不过气
en: The schoolbag on the back weighed so heavily one could hardly breathe

text: 就在读读写写的日子里，十几年过去
en: And so, in days of reading and writing, over a decade slipped by

text: 高三毕业的欣喜，大学毕业的悲鸣
en: The joy of finishing sixth form, the lament of graduating university

text: 找工作，没工作，终于找到工作
en: Looking for a job, no job, and finally finding a job

text: 工作，工作，工作!
en: Work, work, work!

text: 相亲，相亲，相亲。
en: Blind dates, blind dates, blind dates.

text: 车，车，车，车。
en: Car, car, car, car.

text: 房，房，房，房。
en: House, house, house, house.

text: 背后那么重，到底是什么呢？
en: What on earth is that heaviness on the back?

text: 我把他倒出来，原来全是焦虑
en: I poured it all out, and it turned out to be nothing but anxiety

text: 男人真实的一面是什么呢？
en: What is a man's true side?

text: 甩开焦虑，开心就行
en: Shake off the anxiety — just be happy

text: 你和我妈一起掉水里,我肯定是先救我妈的,这种问题就真别问了,有啥意思呢,好像你就不会先救你妈似的
en: If you and my mum fell into the water, I would definitely save my mum first. Really, don't ask this sort of question. What's the point, as if you wouldn't save your own mum first?

text: 都喜欢看美女的，从娃娃到老头都喜欢瞧漂亮姑娘,说什么啊我脸盲啊，啊在我这个帅逼眼里姑娘都那样,那说来是打发你
en: Everyone likes looking at beautiful women; from little tots to old men, all enjoy gazing at pretty girls. What do you mean you're face-blind, or that in the eyes of a handsome bloke like me all girls look the same? That's just fobbing you off.

text: 一般没什么太坎坷的人生经历,太曲折的心路历程的,在外表和内涵两方面，不会有太明显的侧重。
en: Those with no particularly rough life experiences or tangled emotional journeys tend not to show a marked preference for either appearance or inner substance.

text: 甚至脑子若是好使，为人靠谱,脸平淡一点也没什么
en: Even if the mind is sharp and the person reliable, a plain face is no big deal

text: 真不瞎,眼真不瞎。
en: I'm really not blind; my eyes really aren't blind.

text: 说你脸左边有点灰,眼皮咋这么红，不是不知道你私下在倒腾,只是想隐晦表达那不好看而已。
en: Saying the left side of your face looks a bit grey and why your eyelids are so red — it's not that I don't know what you're up to in private; I just want to hint, discreetly, that it doesn't look good.

text: 看不出你换发型,穿了新衣服,那是因为觉得就那样吧,若有天你特别美,那肯定是能发现的
en: Not noticing that you changed your hairstyle or wore new clothes is simply because it's thought to be so-so; but if one day you were especially beautiful, it would surely be noticed

text: 对小妹妹那一款,普遍初始好感都挺高的
en: For the younger-girl type, the initial favourable impression is generally quite high

text: 说什么对你一见钟情，不过是观谈吐打扮,觉得宜家宜室罢了,醒醒
en: Talk of love at first sight for you is merely noticing your speech and dress and thinking you'd make a good wife and mother. Wake up.

text: 老实说吧,这问题底下的回答,女的大部分说的是废话,男的大部分没说实话, 若是有小姑娘还真认真看的,长点心吧，看完笑笑就算了
en: To be honest, among the replies beneath this question, most women talk nonsense and most men don't tell the truth. If there are any young girls who really read them seriously, wise up — just laugh it off once you've read.

text: 不是每个男人都像公众号里写得那么糟糕。
en: Not every man is as awful as he's written up in the WeChat public account.

text: 在这个薄情的时代，请相信，依旧有男生，会喜欢你很久很久。
en: In this unfeeling age, please believe that there are still boys who will like you for a very, very long time.

text: 在两性关系中，女性相对于男生有着更多的不安全感，女粉群里经常讨论的话题，就是担心遇到那些不负责，不爱自己的男生。
en: In relationships between the sexes, women feel more insecurity than men. A topic often discussed in female fan groups is the worry of meeting those irresponsible boys who don't love them.

text: 甚至有人会问：“男生真的会喜欢一个女生很久吗？
en: Some even ask: “Will boys really like a girl for a very long time?”

text: ”“爱情是不是只是男人的身外之物？
en: ”“Is love merely a man's dispensable possession?

text: 会的，男生真的会坚持喜欢一个女生很久很久。
en: Yes, boys really will persist in liking a girl for a very, very long time.

text: 其实，我们一直都喜欢你，我们一直都忘不了你——这是我们男生，从来不曾告诉你们的秘密。
en: In fact, we have always liked you; we have never been able to forget you — this is the secret we boys have never told you.

text: 1.你是无意穿堂风 却偏偏引山洪
en: 1. You were an unintended draught through the passage, yet you stirred a mountain flood

text: 小男生的第一次动心，真的是不要命的。
en: A young boy's first stir of affection is truly reckless.

text: 情感咨询中，百分之九十以上深陷情感问题的男生大多数都是第一次恋爱，或者第一次暗恋。
en: In relationship counselling, over ninety per cent of the boys trapped in emotional troubles are mostly on their first relationship, or their first secret crush.

text: 三个女人一台戏？
en: Three women make a drama?

text: 初恋的男生一个人能撑得起一个百老汇。
en: A boy in his first love could fill a whole Broadway by himself.

text: 你对他笑一下，他连孩子名字都想好了。
en: You smile at him once, and he has already thought up the children's names.

text: 你和你同桌借一下橡皮擦，他都感觉自己被绿了。
en: You borrow an eraser from your deskmate, and he already feels cuckolded.

text: 一个自大冲动的小野兽第一次收敛的像一只小狗，自卑又怯懦，小心翼翼的试探着你对他的态度，他会偷偷给你买好早点放在你的桌子里，他会努力学习想要报考你未来要去地方的学校，他会因为兄弟开了一句你平胸的玩笑而勃然大怒......这些举动，甚至你们没在一起，他单相思都会这么做。
en: A conceited, impulsive little wild beast restrains himself for the first time like a small dog, inferior and timid, cautiously testing your attitude towards him. He will secretly buy breakfast and slip it into your desk; he will study hard, hoping to apply to a school in the place you will go to in future; he will fly into a rage at a mate's joke about your flat chest... These acts he will do even in unrequited love, even if you two are not together.

text: 啧啧啧
en: Tsk, tsk, tsk

text: 这个时候的小男生，连今天留了什么作业都拎不清，但是已经脑补出了几十年后你们白头偕老的日子，规划的一清二胡楚。
en: A little boy at this stage can't even work out what homework was set today, yet he has already imagined the days of growing old together decades on, planning it all out with perfect clarity.

text: 但是太不成熟的感情幼稚而又冲动，他表达爱意的形式低级到像是在性骚扰——强行的尬聊，跟屁虫一样的尾随，疯狂利用全班同学造势......你可以说那是单纯，也可以说他萌，但是长此以往，人和人都会觉得尴尬和厌烦的。
en: But such immature feelings are childish and impulsive; the way he expresses love is so crude it borders on sexual harassment — forced awkward chit-chat, tailing you like a clingy shadow, frantically using the whole class to stir up attention... You can call it innocence, you can call him cute, but kept up long term, anyone would find it awkward and tiresome.

text: 他们尝到了爱，却不懂得什么是爱，所以他们多年如一日的上演着只给自己看的苦情剧，念念不忘。
en: They have tasted love but do not understand what love is, so year after year they act out a tragic romance meant only for their own eyes, never forgetting.

text: 一厢情愿，有始无终。
en: Unrequited love — a beginning without an end.

text: 多少年后，当别人都觉得他成熟稳重，觉得他有担当有责任心时，他总会笑一笑，然后想着那个当初教会他成长的人——
en: Many years later, when others see him as mature and steady, as someone with a sense of duty and responsibility, he will always smile, and think of the person who first taught him to grow —

text: “你看到了吗？
en: “Did you see that?

text: 2.给你最后的疼爱 是手放开
en: 2. The final tenderness I show you is letting go

text: 如果说上一次那种喜欢一个人很久很久回想起来是甜，是在多年后同学聚会时自我调侃引起哄堂大笑的梗，那这一次的很久很久，是痛，是欲言又止最后点燃的一支烟。
en: If the previous kind of liking someone for a very long time is sweet in recollection — a joke that, years later at a class reunion, draws roars of laughter at one's own expense — then this time's very long time is pain, is a cigarette lit at last after words left unspoken.

text: 老天爷还是仁慈的，他尽可能的让每一个善良的人都遇到爱，老天爷亦是冷酷的，他可没给你承诺你能留住爱。
en: The heavens are still merciful; they let every kind-hearted person encounter love. Yet the heavens are also cruel — they never promised you that you could keep that love.

text: 小男生长成了大男孩，你们也许在最好的年龄遇到了，彼此有着最青春的外表，也有着最丰富的感情。
en: The little boy grew into a young man, and perhaps you met at the best age, each with the freshest looks and the richest feelings.

text: 多谢你们浓烈的爱恨情仇，养活了多少自媒体的同行啊。
en: Thank you for your intense love, hate, passion and sorrow — how many fellow self-media creators you have kept fed.

text: 大男孩长大了，知道收拾自己了，也渐渐开始和老司机学着怎么去撩妹，也被身边的哥们鼓动着开始尝试和你联系。
en: The young man grew up; he learned to tidy himself, and gradually began learning from old hands how to chat up girls, and was egged on by the mates around him to start trying to get in touch with you.

text: 好好珍惜你们现在的时光吧，没几年了。
en: Treasure your time together now — there aren't many years left.

text: 几年之后，当现实的问题接踵而至，当双方父母要求见家长的呼声越来越强烈，你们开始意识到一个严峻的问题：
en: A few years on, when real problems come one after another, when the calls from both sets of parents to meet the family grow ever louder, you begin to realise a grave problem:

text: 有情，不能饮水饱，那句我养你啊是要钱的。
en: With love you cannot live on water alone; that 'I'll look after you' is something that costs money.

text: 而大部分男生在这个年纪恰恰是资源的低谷期——他要独立不能再接受父母的供养，他要慢慢磨练才能成长为工作中的骨干。
en: Yet most boys at this age are precisely at a low point in resources — he must stand on his own and can no longer rely on his parents' support; he must gradually hone himself before he can grow into a mainstay at work.

text: 但是时间不等人啊，看着花呗的额度，想想微薄的薪水，再看看不可理喻的房价......我就不说职场的勾心斗角和充满血汗泪的晋升之路了，别没等看完就有人跳楼了。
en: But time waits for no one. Look at the Huabei credit limit, think of the meagre salary, then look at the absurd house prices... I won't even mention the office intrigue and the promotion path drenched in blood, sweat and tears — lest someone jump off a building before finishing reading.

text: 后来我发现，生活真正残酷的地方，不在于它的正面角色没有故事中那么好，而是它的反派角色并没有故事中那么坏。
en: Later I realised that the truly cruel part of life is not that its protagonists are not as good as in the stories, but that its villains are not as bad as in the stories.

text: 和大男孩竞争，并打算横刀夺爱的未必是顶着啤酒肚的油腻大爷，而是一个个已经有了稳定收入和一定阅历的成熟男人。
en: The ones competing with the grown boy and meaning to steal his love are not necessarily greasy old men with beer bellies, but mature men, one after another, who already have a steady income and a certain depth of experience.

text: 见识，经济条件，情商，社会认可度，分分钟碾压大男孩。
en: Worldly experience, financial means, emotional intelligence, social standing — they crush the grown boy in every respect.

text: 你说男生神经大条？
en: You say boys are oblivious?

text: 不，他们有时太清楚了。
en: No — sometimes they are all too clear.

text: 他们太清楚了你可以选择更好的，他们太清楚了你现在和他们在一起就是在赌博。
en: They are all too clear that you could choose better; they are all too clear that being with them now is a gamble.

text: 你不走，他们会咬着牙含着泪把你推开；你主动走，他们会抱头痛哭嫌弃自己没本事。
en: If you won't leave, they will clench their teeth and, with tears, push you away; if you leave of your own accord, they will weep bitterly, despising themselves for being useless.

text: 这种遗憾和悔恨，伴随着曾经的甜蜜和海誓山盟，造成的伤人的喜欢，会是他们心中永远的一根刺。
en: This regret and remorse, together with the sweetness and solemn vows of the past, breeds a love that wounds — a thorn that will stay in their hearts forever.

text: 有些人，把遗憾和痛苦变成了藏在心中的利刃，但还有很多人，将那未曾兑现的诺言变成了埋在心中的种子。
en: Some turn regret and pain into a sharp blade hidden in the heart, but many others turn those unfulfilled promises into seeds buried in the heart.

text: “人都不在了，为什么还要这么努力，她已经看不到了。
en: “The person is gone — why still work so hard? She can no longer see it.

text: “不重要，重要的是我答应过她我会成为更好的人，说到就要做到。
en: “It doesn't matter. What matters is that I promised her I would become a better person, and a promise made must be kept.

text: 3.有时候会突然忘了 我还在爱着你
en: 3. Sometimes I suddenly forget that I'm still loving you

text: 心头的朱砂痣不会问你要不要下面给你吃，床头的白月光也不会考虑粥要不要温，人最后还是需要深夜里客厅里亮着的那一盏等你回家的灯。
en: The cinnabar mole in your heart won't ask whether you want noodles cooked for you, and the white moonlight by your bed won't wonder whether the congee should be warmed; in the end, what a person needs is that one lamp left on in the sitting room late at night, waiting for you to come home.

text: 我说过，婚姻就是一件爬满了虱子的华服，很多细节经不起细看。
en: I have said that marriage is a magnificent robe crawling with lice — many of its details cannot bear close inspection.

text: 但是华服终究也是华服，秀水摊上的廉价货还是和它比不了。
en: But a magnificent robe is, after all, still a magnificent robe; the cheap goods from the Xiushui stall still can't compare with it.

text: 有很多人都抱怨婚姻是爱情的坟墓，但是我觉得，婚姻是激情的坟墓，而未必是爱情的坟墓。
en: Many complain that marriage is the grave of love, but I think marriage is the grave of passion, not necessarily the grave of love.

text: 的确没了一夜七次的频率，但它变成了为你打好的洗脚水。
en: True, the frequency of seven times a night is gone, but it has turned into the foot-washing water prepared for you.

text: 的确没了生个孩子叫什么的讨论，但它变成了看着孩子蹒跚学步时的相视一笑。
en: True, the discussions of what to name a child are gone, but it has become the smile you share while watching your child toddle along.

text: 的确没了各种小鹿乱撞的情节，但是那句“都老夫老妻了还来这一套”的责怪我也听出了欣喜。
en: True, the various fluttering-heart moments are gone, but in that reproach of 'We're an old married couple, why still do this' I also hear delight.

text: 我承认，很多人的婚姻的确是为了结婚而结婚，但是随着时代的进步，越来越多的年轻人开始发出了“嫁给爱情”的宣言，而且单身人士虽然以“单身狗”自嘲，收到的歧视相对于过去已经少了太多太多。
en: I admit that many people's marriages are indeed marriages for the sake of marrying, but as times advance, more and more young people have begun to declare that they will 'marry for love', and although single people mock themselves as 'single dogs', the discrimination they face is far, far less than in the past.

text: 所以我坚信，越来越多的人，最后的婚姻是建立在爱的基础上。
en: So I firmly believe that more and more people's eventual marriage is built on a foundation of love.

text: 这个时候，他真的会喜欢你很久很久，只不过太久了他都快忘了。
en: At this point, he really will like you for a very, very long time — it's just that, after so long, he has nearly forgotten it himself.

text: 那融入生活点滴的默契，那炒菜时少放的一撮盐，那小心翼翼规划的理财，其实都是喜欢，都是爱啊。
en: That tacit understanding woven into the little details of life, that pinch of salt held back when cooking, that carefully planned budgeting — these are all affection, all love.

text: 男人本来就不善于表达感情，更何况已经是老夫老妻。
en: Men are, by nature, not good at expressing feelings, let alone when they are already an old married couple.

text: 他的确不再躺在草地里搂着你看星星，边看边说将来要和你去遍天涯海角。
en: He truly no longer lies with you in the grass, arm around you, watching the stars and saying he'll travel to the ends of the earth with you.

text: 但是拉着你前进的手，可是从来没有放下过。
en: But the hand that pulls you forward has never, ever let go.

text: 只不过啊，那曾经的甜言蜜语，变成了被孩子翻到过去情书时满脸通红的一巴掌。
en: It's just that those sweet nothings of the past have become a blushing slap when the child digs out an old love letter.

text: 做心理咨询的人最容易得心理问题，因为他们见识到了太多别人想都不敢想的内心
en: Those who do psychological counselling are most prone to psychological problems, because they witness too many inner worlds others dare not even imagine

text: 做情感咨询的人，最容易不相信爱情，因为他们见识了太多的算计，贪欲，和背叛
en: Those who do relationship counselling are most prone to stop believing in love, because they have seen too much calculation, greed and betrayal

text: 但是我始终相信，我也愿意相信，每个人的内心深处，一定还留着最温柔的一面
en: But I have always believed, and I am willing to believe, that deep in everyone's heart there must still remain the gentlest side.

text: 那个看起来沉默寡言的男生，那个看起来玩世不恭的浪子，那个看起来无坚不摧的英雄，其实他们有个秘密，一直都没有告诉你。
en: That boy who seems reticent, that prodigal who seems cynical about the world, that hero who seems invincible — in fact they share a secret they have never told you.

text: 你问他他还喜欢你吗，你问他他还爱你吗，你想让他说出动听的情话，想让他表达出来内心压抑的感情，但是他总是给出一个能把你气晕过去的黑人问号脸，再配上一句抑扬顿挫的：“啊？
en: You ask him if he still likes you, you ask him if he still loves you, you want him to utter sweet words, to express those suppressed feelings — but he always gives you a black question-mark face that could make you faint from rage, and then follows it with a rhythmically inflected 'Eh?'

text: 但是，这不重要，重要的是，那些甜和痛塑造过的他，那些“不足为外人道”磨砺出的温柔，最后都给了你。
en: But this doesn't matter. What matters is that the sweetness and pain that shaped him, the tenderness tempered by things 'not to be shared with outsiders', all of it was given to you in the end.

text: 姑娘，请你一定要相信那个秘密，请你一定要相信那个句不曾说出口的话。
en: Girl, please do believe that secret; please do believe those words that were never spoken aloud.

text: 他真的会喜欢你很久，爱你很久，为你成为更好的人，给你更多的爱吗？
en: Will he really like you for a long time, love you for a long time, become a better person for you, and give you more love?

text: 会的，他会的。
en: Yes, he will.

text: 很久，很久。
en: For a long time, a very long time.

text: 很多，很多。
en: A great deal, a great deal.

text: 以上
en: The above.

text: 码字不易，如果帮到你，记得给个赞哈~
en: Writing isn't easy — if this helped you, do give it a like, yeah~

text: 公众号：hongsang1989，每天分享一个实用的情感攻略。
en: WeChat public account: hongsang1989, sharing one practical relationship guide every day.

text: 国家二级心理咨询师，接受恋爱和婚姻问题咨询，咨询请通过知乎付费咨询功能
en: Nationally certified Level-2 psychological counsellor, accepting consultations on romantic and marital issues; for consultations please use Zhihu's paid consultation feature
